penalties.authority: Office of the Principal Commissioner of Customs (Import), ACC Mumbai
penalties.details: Duty on one of Bill of Entry was short paid at concessional rate by availing inapplicable notification. Though differential duty along with interest was paid in response to consultative letter issued by department, the concerned authority issued order dated 19.05.2026 imposing penalty under Section 114A of the Customs Act, 1962.
penalties.impact: Duty of Rs. 25,581/-, Interest of Rs. 5,025/- and Penalty equal to duty and interest under Section 114A of the Customs Act, 1962. The Company has option to pay reduced penalty, being 25% of applicable penalty if payment is made within 30 days of the order. The Company has made payment within 30 days of the order by availing reduced penalty option.

entities.name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu Power Distribution Corporation Ltd

operating_notes.text: Planned capex of ~₹65,000 Cr during FY26-32 to be funded in 70:30 or 75:25 debt to equity ratio.
Net debt to EBITDA improved to 1.4x as on March 31, 2025 from 2.2x as on March 31, 2024.
Total FY26 dividend reached ₹20 per equity share (₹15 interim + ₹5 recommended final).
Share purchase agreement entered on Feb 16, 2026 to acquire 100% of Nabha Power Limited for ₹3,660.87 Cr consideration.
Assigned AA+/Stable for ₹2,500 Cr proposed NCDs by both India Ratings and CRISIL.

holders.name: NPS Trust- A/C Sbi Pension Fund Scheme - State Govt

timeline.summary: CRISIL assigned 'CRISIL AA+/Stable' rating to Torrent Power's proposed ₹4,000 Cr NCDs and reaffirmed ratings on existing debt and bank facilities.
Torrent Power Limited’s **Chaitanya Bhai Chaitanya Shah** scheduled an earnings conference call on **May 13, 2026**, at 09:30 AM IST to discuss Q4 FY26 results.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,406.07 Cr (-0.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹318.2 Cr.
Torrent Power announced credit rating assignments of IND AA+/Stable and Crisil AA+/Stable for ₹2,500 Cr proposed NCDs.

upcoming_events.description: Payment of final dividend of ₹5 per share on or before September 2, 2026
